To achieve a moderate-risk profile, our strategy allocates to equities for growth and income via ETFs, bonds for capital preservation, and commodities as an inflation hedge. These assets serve as effective hedges against inflation, supporting the stability of the portfolio.

Specifically, we allocate 35% to equities, 40% to bonds, and 10% to commodities. The equities portion consists of a well-established company with strong fundamentals and ESG track records, such as Microsoft Corp. The bond allocation focuses on AAA-rated government and corporate issues, including a 1-year and a 2-year maturity structure to fix the laddered maturity structure issue. The commodities portion consists of a diversified basket, including Gold (XAUUSD) Futures. These proposals are evaluated to be within the risk bounds and portfolio constraints.
